title: 2.8 Proportion: Direct and inverse proportion with powers and roots, using y = kx and y = k/x

q.Q1: Q1. y is directly proportional to x². When x = 3, y = 36. Find y when x = 5.

q.Q2: Q2. y is inversely proportional to x. When x = 4, y = 15. Find y when x = 10.

q.Q3: Q3. I is inversely proportional to d². When d = 2, I = 50. Find I when d = 5.

q.Q4: Q4. y is proportional to x³. What happens to y when x is doubled?

q.Q5: Q5. t is inversely proportional to the square root of h. When h = 16, t = 3. Find h when t = 2.

q.Exit ticket: Exit ticket. Write y ∝ 1/x² as an equation.
